sentences.en: I have a lot of friends to support me mentally.
sentences.zh: 我有很多朋友在精神上支持我。

sentences.en: Athletes must be tough not only physically, but also mentally.
sentences.zh: 运动员不仅要在身体上坚强，还要在心理上坚强。

sentences.en: Sami wanted to sell his mentally challenged sister into slavery.
sentences.zh: 萨米想把他智力有障碍的妹妹卖掉为奴。
